body: Una600 MAINLINE-003: ADMITTED for scope (arithmetic and QUESTIONABLE tag/source presence, P2-C, P2-K, P2-E and the P2-A comparison). My own arithmetic (mycheck3.py; no owner, advisory or predecessor script): 90 numbers agree at 1e-12, 0 mismatches; card print 56/56; pins 5/5 and 31/31; tags and the 276 MPa transfer present; inherited inputs 35/35; NFI 10/10, 11/11, 8/8; shear, wrinkle and crush omitted as declared. DEFECT, exact, text only, no number changes: NFI-AL-YIELD-CARRY says the required compressive strength scales with sigma, but the card's sigma_req = pR/(4 tf) is sigma-independent (doubling sigma: ratio 1). NFI-KD says the required modulus scales directly with knockdown, but E_req is proportional to 1/kd (doubling kd: ratio 0.5). Only the pressures and SFs scale as stated. This bears on MAINLINE-004: a larger knockdown lowers the required E. Under the Desk's ruling this check gates nothing. Qualifications: 276 MPa stays QUESTIONABLE and transferred; three fixed rules, not an optimum; no certification.
